project.name: dmt
project.vision: Give Rust applications an embeddable, SQL-persisted engine that runs long-lived, human-in-the-loop agent workflows as a graph with explicit state-machine transitions and resumes them after restarts.

comparators.name: Watermill
comparators.relevance: Go router, handler, middleware, and SQL pub/sub model for coordinated message-driven execution.

comparators.name: Stately XState
comparators.relevance: Statecharts with hierarchical states, guards, actors, and persisted snapshots that resume.

comparators.name: Restate
comparators.relevance: Durable execution with workflows, virtual objects, awakeables, and journaled side effects.

comparators.name: Temporal
comparators.relevance: Workflow-as-code with activities, signals, timers, and long human-in-the-loop waits.

evaluation_lenses.name: Resume after restart
evaluation_lenses.question: Can a run that was killed mid-node or mid-wait complete after the process restarts with every side effect observed exactly once?

evaluation_lenses.name: Human-in-the-loop waits
evaluation_lenses.question: Can a run park on an external decision for days at no runtime cost and continue when the host resolves it?

evaluation_lenses.name: Fan-out and join
evaluation_lenses.question: Can one node spawn parallel branches and a join node run exactly once after a configurable completion policy?

evaluation_lenses.name: Embeddability
evaluation_lenses.question: Can a Rust host add dmt with one store and one registry call, with SQLite for local use and PostgreSQL for shared use, without a separate server?

evaluation_lenses.name: Observability
evaluation_lenses.question: Can an operator or agent list runs, inspect the event history of one run, and see why it is parked or failed?

acceptance_journey: A host app starts a run of the plan, sign-off, implement, review fan-out, fix, open-PR graph against SQLite; the process is killed during the review fan-out and again while waiting for sign-off; after restart the run completes and the host observes every node side effect exactly once.
non_goals: Running or embedding a Restate server in the first milestone.
Distributed or multi-region execution beyond one PostgreSQL database shared by workers.
Instruction-level durability inside a node handler; node side effects are idempotent by step key instead.

related_repositories.role: Prospective consumer: agentic plan, review, and PR workflows after its Rust migration.
Convention reference for workspace layout and xtask gates; embeddable agent runtime that would execute LLM work inside dmt nodes.
